description: Multilingual RAGAS evaluation dataset for Engineer Cafe Navigator (#382)

en.question: What are the opening hours of Engineer Cafe?
How much does it cost to use the coworking space?
en.ground_truth: Engineer Cafe is free. No membership fees or usage charges.

en.question: How do I book a meeting room?
en.ground_truth: Book at 1F reception desk. Advance reservation recommended for busy times.

en.question: What events are happening this week?
en.ground_truth: Check https://engineercafe.jp/ja/events for the latest event schedule.

en.question: Where is Engineer Cafe located?
en.ground_truth: Red Brick Culture Building, 1-28 Tenjin, Chuo-ku, Fukuoka. 5 min walk from Tenjin Station.

en.question: Can I use the space for a team meeting?
en.ground_truth: Yes, 1F meeting rooms and event spaces are available for team meetings.

en.question: What floor is the cafe on?
en.ground_truth: 1st floor (main workspace + reception) and B1F (event space).

en.question: Is there a printer available?
en.ground_truth: Printer available at the 1F workspace area.

en.question: How do I become a member?
en.ground_truth: No membership needed. Free and open to all. Sign in at reception on arrival.

zh.question: 工程师咖啡的营业时间是什么？
使用共享办公空间需要多少钱？
zh.ground_truth: 完全免费。无会员费和使用费。

zh.question: 怎么预约会议室？
zh.ground_truth: 在1楼接待处预约。繁忙时段建议提前预约。

zh.question: 这周有什么活动？
zh.ground_truth: 请查看 https://engineercafe.jp/ja/events 获取最新活动日程。

zh.question: 工程师咖啡在哪里？
zh.ground_truth: 红砖文化馆，福冈市中央区天神1-28。天神站步行5分钟。

zh.question: 工程师咖啡是什么？
zh.ground_truth: 福冈市「工程师友好城市福冈」核心设施。2019年8月开设的免费共享办公·交流空间。

ko.question: 회의실 예약은 어떻게 하나요?
ko.ground_truth: 1층 안내 데스크에서 예약. 혼잡 시 사전 예약 권장.

ko.question: 이번 주에 어떤 이벤트가 있나요?
ko.ground_truth: https://engineercafe.jp/ja/events 에서 최신 이벤트 일정 확인.

ko.question: 엔지니어 카페는 어디에 있나요?
ko.ground_truth: 아카렌가 문화관, 후쿠오카시 주오구 텐진 1-28. 텐진역 도보 5분.

ko.question: 엔지니어 카페란 무엇인가요?
ko.ground_truth: 후쿠오카시 '엔지니어 프렌들리 시티 후쿠오카' 핵심 시설. 2019년 8월 개설 무료 코워킹·교류 공간.
